verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs explicitly support scoped API key authentication (custom scopes to limit third-party/agent access), plus OAuth for tech-partner integrations, which together allow issuing least-privilege credentials suitable for an AI agent (e.g., its own MCP server integration). Missing for 10: no explicit documentation tying scoped keys specifically to agent/MCP use cases, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of scope granularity in practice.
